evidence.reason: The current contract does not require the author-enroll example to include lease opt-in flags. The visible author-reviews text explicitly preserves non-opted-in requests: "The legacy queue, observation and promotion spool schemas and request bytes are unchanged for non-opted-in requests. `author_lease.v:1` and response `v:1` are the only new schema versions" (lines 79-81). So the example without `--review-policy` and `--fallback-reviewer` is valid non-lease enrollment; neither the contract nor the file requires every enrollment example to opt into the lease or be labeled legacy.
